title: chooseResourceHost
responsibility: Choose the admitted computer for a work request from ranked candidates, retaining Tracker choice results

inputs.name: chooseResourceHost.input
inputs.type: { hosts: ResourceHost[]; work: ResourceWork; reservations: ResourceReservation[]; policy: ResourcePlacementPolicy; now: number; }
inputs.description: One placement round: computers, work, reservations, policy and the current time.

outputs.name: chooseResourceHost
outputs.description: The chosen computer with its reasons, or null with the blocking reason for each computer.
